0022600004.text: Both teams are still waiting for their first 2026-27 games, and the Timberwolves visit Miami after sweeping the Heat 2-0 in the 2025-26 season series, including a 122-94 win in Minneapolis on January 6. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Enrique Freeman (shoulder) and Rocco Zikarsky (undisclosed) are day-to-day game-time decisions, while Miami's Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain), and Pelle Larsson (illness) are also day-to-day game-time decisions. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Timberwolves a 50% chance to win.
